note: What the replay harness (operating/autopilot_replay.py) counts as a person's real next action. A provider lists actions (person, time, workflow, the conversation, recipients and records they touched). 'record_actor' reads every store event that names a person as its actor (qualifier 'actor'): per-person activity in BC, the Portal, Sage and FileMaker counts as it lands, with no change here. 'plugins' adds a provider registered by name in operating/autopilot_replay.PLUGINS; an unknown provider refuses the whole file. 'feed_lag_minutes': per record type, how long after its time the live feed first holds it (the MC capture reads tasks about every 90 minutes, measured 2026-11: median 70, p75 132 minutes from an event to its capture); a decision before then was already taken when the feed saw the request, so the replay prepares nothing for it and judges an item from that time. An MC approval or question that happened after the MC capture first read MC live (its first run) is timed instead by its own first captured version: the feed's real cadence that day (the ten-minute fast poll, or hours while the capture was paused); the replay result's 'feed_seen' counts which rule timed each prepared MC item. An MC item is judged only when its horizon also ends by the MC capture's last write of approvals and task events (result 'source_ends'): while that capture is stopped and mail goes on, its items stay unjudged instead of counting as misses.
